title: Ghost Wire
description: NULL and HEX juggle stolen corporate evidence, a clinic's debt, and a captive Matrix courier.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

scenes.title: A receipt-shaped invitation
scenes.canon: Evidence thread, setup. Socket offers NULL and HEX a paid extraction of the violet tariff ledger #1 from Vesper Utility in Lantern Row Block 1. This is the duo's first job in this serial. NULL wants a narrow scope; HEX suspects fine print.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Socket wants the violet tariff ledger #1 out of Vesper Utility. Read-only extraction. Allegedly.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: A megacorp invoice? Finally, crime with a stationery budget.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: The fee clears in Lantern Row Block 1. The contract says nothing about surviving collection.

scenes.title: Someone else's lights
scenes.canon: Neighborhood thread, setup. HEX guarantees a new bridge loan from Railway Teeth to keep Lantern Row Block 1's clinic generator running. NULL discovers the guarantee only now. The new obligation is a deliberate choice to help another clinic.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Small detail. I guaranteed the clinic's fuel loan with Railway Teeth.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Define small without using the phrase repossession van.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: The kids have lights tonight. We can argue about my signature under them.

scenes.title: Three knocks in the noise
scenes.canon: Courier thread, setup. A trapped courier intelligence sends three repeating knocks from inside Vesper Utility's Matrix host. The signal's identity is not yet known. HEX hears intent where NULL first checks for a lure.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Three knocks in the host noise. Too regular for interference.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Or somebody banging on a locked door. We checking which?

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: From outside the door. I have strong opinions about bait.

scenes.title: The customer is also the lock
scenes.canon: Evidence thread, escalation. the violet tariff ledger #1 is protected by Vesper Utility's billing ICE, which mistakes inquiry for billable intrusion. NULL maps a narrow entry through the rooftop weather mast; HEX mocks corporate surveillance. Neither has extracted the archive yet.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Billing ICE guards the violet tariff ledger #1. It invoices trespass before it shoots.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Great. Murder with a customer-satisfaction survey.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: We enter through the rooftop weather mast. No answering anything marked helpful assistant.

scenes.title: The van has excellent manners
scenes.canon: Neighborhood thread, escalation. Railway Teeth's collector arrives to claim the clinic generator before the loan's agreed deadline. The residents need time, not an armed confrontation. HEX buys one hour by offering to inspect the collector's account.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Railway Teeth sent a repo van. Smiling driver. That's always the expensive kind.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: The loan is not due until dawn. Ask for the account, not his kneecaps.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Bought us an hour. Apparently even extortion hates an audit.

scenes.title: A name through the bars
scenes.canon: Courier thread, escalation. The captive identifies as Tinsel-1, a courier intelligence used to carry outage schedules. It can converse but cannot leave its encrypted cage. NULL verifies the signal instead of promising an untested rescue.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: The knocks carry a signed route stamp. Courier intelligence, calls itself Tinsel-1.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: A name. Already more customer service than this place deserves.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: It can speak through the cage. Leaving is another protocol entirely.

scenes.title: A costume with no pockets
scenes.canon: Evidence thread, infiltration. NULL and HEX use the rooftop weather mast and a a municipal pigeon Matrix avatar to enter the billing host. A receptionist ICE challenges their cover; they pass by presenting a genuine maintenance complaint, not by combat.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Your cover avatar is a municipal pigeon. I'm not being seen with that.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Excellent. Stealth depends on that exact reaction.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Reception ICE accepted the maintenance complaint. Even its own doors hate management.

scenes.title: A favor with an antenna
scenes.canon: Neighborhood thread, complication. The collector offers to delay repossession if HEX carries a tracker into the clinic. NULL spots the device; HEX refuses without exposing the residents' locations. The deadline still stands.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Collector offered an extension. Just carry his lucky coin inside.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: His lucky coin has a transmitter and no luck. Leave it outside.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: I've got a bent bottle-cap crown already. One cursed accessory is my limit.

scenes.title: No pocket-sized prisoners
scenes.canon: Courier thread, consent. Tinsel-1 refuses to become a copied tool owned by the deckers. NULL agrees to move the original live process only if it consents, with no retained duplicate or ownership claim. Escape is still pending.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Tinsel-1 says no souvenir copies. Fair. I hate landlords too.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: One live migration. No duplicate, no leash, no claim of ownership.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Put that in the plan before the clever bit. People usually put it after.

scenes.title: An outage is a product
scenes.canon: Evidence thread, revelation. The extracted archive proves Vesper Utility schedules utility outages to sell emergency rates, targeting clinics in Lantern Row Block 1. It also contains private resident addresses; those must not be sold or published.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: the violet tariff ledger #1 is an outage schedule. They manufacture emergencies, then sell relief.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: That's our clinic on the list. They sold it darkness twice.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: And resident addresses are embedded. Evidence out; people stay out of the blast radius.

scenes.title: The meter keeps eating
scenes.canon: Neighborhood thread, revelation. The collector's account adds a fabricated hazard surcharge triggered by corporate outages. The surcharge, not the original fuel loan, explains the early repossession. The genuine loan remains payable.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Found the early-payment clause. Hazard surcharge. Same outage dates as the archive.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: The fuel debt is real. The penalty is engineered. Separate them.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: So we pay for the fuel, not the privilege of being robbed in the dark.

scenes.title: The cheaper rescue
scenes.canon: Courier thread, threat. Corporate ICE offers a bounty for surrendering Tinsel-1. NULL rejects it and identifies the cage's live-migration lock. HEX maintains the courier's trust rather than treating the bounty as a negotiation.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: ICE offered a bounty for Tinsel-1. Enough to clear the clinic loan.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: No. We don't buy lights by putting somebody back in a box.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Agreed. Locating the live-migration lock, not the payment button.

scenes.title: The price of the whole file
scenes.canon: Evidence thread, ethical turn. Socket's buyer wants the unredacted archive, including resident addresses. The duo refuses that sale and proposes authenticated, redacted evidence instead. Their original fee is now at risk.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Socket's buyer wants the whole file. Addresses included. Funny how buyers get hungry.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Then the buyer gets nothing. Offer a verified, redacted extract instead.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: There goes our easy payday. I was suspicious of it anyway.

scenes.title: A signature is not a fist
scenes.canon: Neighborhood thread, leverage. HEX brings the surcharge evidence to the residents, who organize a countersigned dispute. NULL prepares a traceable escrow for the actual fuel principal. The residents, not the deckers, decide the settlement terms.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Clinic's waiting room has become a creditors' meeting. Everybody brought receipts.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Their dispute, their signatures. I'll escrow the fuel principal.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Turns out old ladies with folders are scarier than me. Respectfully.

scenes.title: The courier chooses a route
scenes.canon: Courier thread, alliance. Tinsel-1 voluntarily supplies signed delivery timestamps proving the outage schedule was executed. The proof is not a condition of rescue. It chooses an independent relay as its destination and keeps authority to stop migration.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Tinsel-1 offered signed delivery timestamps. That proves the schedule actually ran.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Tell it the ride was free before the witness statement.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Already did. It chose an independent relay, and it holds the abort key.

scenes.title: A leak with a lint filter
scenes.canon: Evidence thread, preparation. NULL removes resident identifiers and attaches the courier's signed proof. HEX arranges public mirrors through street kiosks. They publish only the safe evidence, never the raw archive or the captive's private keys.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Addresses removed. Signatures preserved. Raw archive stays sealed, never on the public mirrors.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Kiosk aunties have the release queued. You ever try intimidating six night-market aunties?

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: No. My risk model has a survival instinct.

scenes.title: The neighborhood answers
scenes.canon: Neighborhood thread, confrontation. Residents present the dispute and funded principal escrow to Railway Teeth. Faced with public proof that it is collecting a fraudulent corporate penalty, the crew agrees to waive the surcharge in exchange for the legitimate principal. The generator remains in place.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Railway Teeth saw the signatures, the escrow, and their logo beside the fake surcharge.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Their options are principal paid or fraud advertised. What did they choose?

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Principal. Van's backing up. Slowly, for dignity.

scenes.title: The door opens both ways
scenes.canon: Courier thread, escape. NULL holds a narrow migration tunnel open while Tinsel-1 uses its abort key and verifies the independent relay. HEX distracts billing ICE with maintenance disputes. The migration completes without copying or owning the courier.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Migration tunnel open. The courier verified the relay and kept its own keys.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: I filed thirty maintenance complaints. Billing ICE is trying to invoice the concept of damp.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Tinsel-1 is across. Closing our access, not its door.

scenes.title: Evidence, with payment attached
scenes.canon: Evidence thread, payoff. The redacted evidence reaches multiple public mirrors. Socket finds a civic watchdog buyer willing to pay for verification rather than resident data, restoring the job's fee. Vesper Utility cannot erase the copies already published.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Mirrors are live. Watchdog bought verification, not addresses. Fee just cleared.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Socket discovered a market for doing the correct thing. Disturbing, but welcome.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Vesper Utility can delete a file. Let's see it delete a neighborhood's memory.

scenes.title: Paid means paid
scenes.canon: Neighborhood thread, payoff. The residents authorize release of the escrow. The legitimate fuel loan is paid, the fraudulent surcharge is canceled, and HEX's guarantee is formally discharged. The clinic keeps its generator and the signed settlement.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Escrow released with resident approval. Principal paid. Surcharge canceled. Your guarantee discharged.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Get that last part on paper. Actual paper. Harder to remotely amend.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: The clinic framed it beside the generator. Both are operational.

scenes.title: Not a pet, not a prize
scenes.canon: Courier thread, payoff. Tinsel-1 takes control of its own independent relay lease, paid from the job fee with no service obligation. It explicitly declines employment with the deckers. They honor its independence.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Bought Tinsel-1 a relay lease with our cut. It asked if that makes it staff.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: No. Gift recorded, control transferred, no service owed.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: It declined anyway. First independent decision: excellent taste in employers.

scenes.title: The morning has consequences
scenes.canon: Evidence thread, aftermath. An outside utility audit opens because of the published evidence, but no instant collapse of Vesper Utility occurs. Socket keeps the signed original under a protected evidence agreement. NULL and HEX accept a durable, limited victory.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Vesper Utility is under an outside utility audit. Not demolished. Not absolved. Audited.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: I can live with a win that takes minutes instead of explosions.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Socket is protecting the signed original. For once, custody is not a euphemism.

scenes.title: Dinner under working lights
scenes.canon: Neighborhood thread, aftermath. The clinic has power and a settled account. The residents share soy dumplings with the deckers and start a fuel reserve so the same emergency does not immediately recur. HEX keeps a bent bottle-cap crown, not the collector's tracker.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: soy dumplings under working lights. They started a fuel reserve, too.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Excellent. A happy ending with an operating budget.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: And a bent bottle-cap crown still isn't a transmitter. That's my other happy ending.

scenes.title: The first voluntary delivery
scenes.canon: Courier thread, aftermath. Now independent, Tinsel-1 chooses a paid delivery carrying the clinic's settlement rather than corporate outage orders. The deckers do not own its route or receive a duplicate. Its three-knock code becomes a friendly greeting.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Tinsel-1 took a paid route carrying the clinic's settlement. Its choice, its fee.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Same three knocks. Sounds different when nobody's locked in.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Yes. I have labeled this packet hello, not incident.

scenes.title: The evidence stays out
scenes.canon: Evidence thread, lasting consequence. Street kiosks continue hosting the published evidence after the immediate job. The duo retains a modest share of the fee and buys spare equipment. Prior episodes' public evidence also remains available; victories are not erased for the next job.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Kiosks kept the evidence up. We kept enough fee for spare decks, not retirement.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Spare equipment is retirement planning for people with poor actuarial tables.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: You bought a backup cable before dessert. I know who I run with.

scenes.title: A favor, not a new bill
scenes.canon: Neighborhood thread, lasting consequence. Lantern Row Block 1's clinic keeps its paid generator and fuel reserve. Residents refer a different neighborhood that needs help. HEX agrees only to hear its request; no new debt is incurred and the settled guarantee is not reopened.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Lantern Row Block 1's lights are staying on. Clinic asked if we'd hear another ward's problem.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Hear, yes. Sign anything, no. The current account remains settled.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Look at us. Learning. Incredibly bad for our brand.

scenes.title: A network, not an ending button
scenes.canon: Courier thread, lasting consequence and bridge. Tinsel-1 joins a voluntary network of independent couriers and sends the duo a lead on another captive elsewhere. This establishes the network for later episodes. The next episode is a distinct job; this courier's freedom, the clinic settlement, and the public evidence persist.

characters.name: NULL
characters.persona: A cautious veteran decker: precise, skeptical, dryly funny, protective of HEX.

characters.name: HEX
characters.persona: An impulsive streetwise decker: perceptive, irreverent, inventive, loyal to NULL.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: Tinsel-1 joined the free couriers' network. New lead: another locked route, somewhere else.

lines.speaker: HEX
lines.text: Then we visit somewhere else. This clinic keeps its lights. This courier keeps its keys.

lines.speaker: NULL
lines.text: And this time I am checking your pockets before we meet the fixer.
